operation.name: Insert
operation.sql: INSERT INTO photos (photo_id, access_hash, has_stickers, dc_id, date2, has_video, input_file_name, ext, sha256, blob_id) VALUES (:photo_id, :access_hash, :has_stickers, :dc_id, :date2, :has_video, :input_file_name, :ext, :sha256, :blob_id)

operation.name: SelectByPhotoId
operation.sql: SELECT id, photo_id, access_hash, has_stickers, dc_id, date2, has_video, input_file_name, ext FROM photos WHERE photo_id = :photo_id LIMIT 1
